audit_scope.counting_rule: Each visible atomic digit-bearing token is an occurrence. Source IDs and Fix Card IDs are counted as whole tokens. Spelled-out numeric words are also counted. The HTML and PDF render the same content, so matching occurrences are recorded once with both surfaces rather than doubled.
audit_scope.url_rule: Numeric strings that exist only inside href targets, SVG geometry, CSS, metadata, or ARIA text are not visible page occurrences. No URL is printed as visible text; therefore the visible URL-only-token count is zero.

substantive_lineage.label: Market Demand-Supply score
substantive_lineage.unit: score points on a 0-100 high-good scale
substantive_lineage.derivation: Weighted sum = 56.75; nearest-whole-point rounding = 57.
substantive_lineage.explanation: Directionally supportive city age/income signals are balanced by neutral unknown supply and growth components plus limited market-data confidence.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Summarizes market demand-supply conditions while making the mixed, public-only method visible.
substantive_lineage.limitations: City statistics are not drive-time catchment measurements; complete supply, provider, VDU, growth, and patient-choice inputs are missing. Neutral 50 bands preserve unknowns rather than proving average conditions.

substantive_lineage.label: Competitive Pressure index
substantive_lineage.display_value: 57 / 100 (not displayed; internal input to Room to Win)
substantive_lineage.unit: score points on a 0-100 high-pressure scale
substantive_lineage.derivation: Weighted sum = 56.75; nearest-whole-point rounding = 57.
substantive_lineage.explanation: Named routes and public service overlap support elevated directional pressure, while incomplete supply and access evidence stay neutral.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: It is intentionally hidden because higher pressure is worse; its high-good inversion, Room to Win, is the client-facing score.
substantive_lineage.limitations: The named routed peer set is not a complete office/provider census or population-weighted patient-choice set.

substantive_lineage.label: Room to Win score
substantive_lineage.unit: score points on a 0-100 high-good scale
substantive_lineage.explanation: High-good inversion of the internal pressure score; 43 is labeled tight.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Presents competitive headroom in the same higher-is-better direction as every other displayed score.
substantive_lineage.limitations: Any material change to the incomplete pressure evidence moves Room to Win in the opposite direction.

substantive_lineage.label: Practice Competitiveness score
substantive_lineage.unit: score points on a 0-100 high-good scale
substantive_lineage.derivation: Weighted sum = 57.50; nearest-whole-point rounding = 58.
substantive_lineage.explanation: Published booking, access, service breadth, and conversion clarity support positive bands; visibility, reputation, and convenience remain neutral or unmeasured.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Shows the practice's directional public competitiveness beside Room to Win.
substantive_lineage.limitations: No peer-normalized rank grid, review export, live access, conversion, capacity, or operating-performance data.

substantive_lineage.label: Client Opportunity score
substantive_lineage.unit: score points on a 0-100 high-good scale
substantive_lineage.derivation: Weighted sum = 53.65; nearest-whole-point rounding = 54.
substantive_lineage.explanation: The computed market score and a fixable digital-measurement gap raise the score; white space, differentiation upside, access fixability, and execution simplicity remain neutral until measured.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Hero metric summarizing actionable owner upside without treating missing operating proof as opportunity.
substantive_lineage.limitations: No leakage, capacity, specialty economics, staffing, or execution cadence is assumed.

substantive_lineage.label: Digital Presence score
substantive_lineage.unit: score points on a 0-100 high-good scale
substantive_lineage.derivation: Weighted sum = 56.75; nearest-whole-point rounding = 57.
substantive_lineage.explanation: Public bookability, site structure, and specialty content are directionally supportive; findability, reputation, and social/local proof remain neutral.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Separates the existing digital surface from unmeasured findability and trust baselines.
substantive_lineage.limitations: No rank grid, peer-normalized review export, Core Web Vitals, conversion, or verified social/local-proof comparison.

substantive_lineage.label: Dry eye / ocular surface specialty score
substantive_lineage.unit: score points on a 0-100 high-good scale
substantive_lineage.derivation: Weighted sum = 51.50; nearest-whole-point rounding = 52.
substantive_lineage.explanation: City age proxy and a verified current offer support research; direct peer overlap, limited evidence, and unknown capacity/economics constrain the score.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Marks dry eye as research-next, not a forecast or proven gap.
substantive_lineage.limitations: Catchment demand, conversion, capacity, referrals, outcomes, and economics are unmeasured.

substantive_lineage.label: Myopia management specialty score
substantive_lineage.unit: score points on a 0-100 high-good scale
substantive_lineage.derivation: Weighted sum = 51.50; nearest-whole-point rounding = 52.
substantive_lineage.explanation: City child-share proxy and a verified current offer support research; published regional overlap, limited evidence, and unknown delivery/economics constrain the score.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Marks myopia management as research-next, not a forecast or proven gap.
substantive_lineage.limitations: Catchment family demand, starts, retention, capacity, referrals, outcomes, and economics are unmeasured.

substantive_lineage.label: Specialty contact lenses score
substantive_lineage.unit: score points on a 0-100 high-good scale
substantive_lineage.derivation: Weighted sum = 50.75; nearest-whole-point rounding = 51.
substantive_lineage.explanation: The public specialty-contact offer is verified, while local demand, competitive gap, access/capacity, referral fit, economics, and most evidence remain neutral or limited.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Marks specialty contacts as research-next, not a forecast or proven gap.
substantive_lineage.limitations: No catchment demand, specialty-depth peer audit, fitting volume, capacity, referrals, outcomes, or economics.

substantive_lineage.label: Primary catchment duration
substantive_lineage.unit: minutes
substantive_lineage.formula: Exurban market type -> 20-minute primary window under canonical catchment table.
substantive_lineage.derivation: The canonical calculations table assigns exurban markets a 20-minute primary and 30-minute extended window; the run classifies Morton as exurban directionally.
substantive_lineage.explanation: The page uses 20 minutes to warn that city facts do not describe the selected drive-time catchment.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Prevents city-versus-catchment substitution.
substantive_lineage.limitations: No polygon isochrone, catchment density surface, patient-origin set, or trip-tolerance study was completed.

substantive_lineage.label: Focus On Eyes route minutes
substantive_lineage.unit: minutes
substantive_lineage.formula: OSRM duration 244.3 seconds / 60 = 4.071666..., stored and displayed as 4.07 minutes.
substantive_lineage.derivation: Stored R01 OSRM point-to-point route response from the subject origin to Focus On Eyes.
substantive_lineage.explanation: Nearest displayed direct peer route duration.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Supports the directional statement that a close Morton peer exists.
substantive_lineage.confidence: high for the stored route observation
substantive_lineage.limitations: Single practice-origin route with no live traffic or time-of-day model; not an isochrone or patient-origin choice set.

substantive_lineage.label: 30-day Fix Card measurement window
substantive_lineage.unit: days
substantive_lineage.derivation: Each of the three canonical do-now Fix Cards has time_to_value = 30_days and proof built around a 30-day baseline; CALCULATIONS describes fixability as 30-90 days.
substantive_lineage.explanation: Measurement horizon, not a forecast period or promised performance result.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Makes the bounded first action and evidence window concrete.
substantive_lineage.confidence: high as the prescribed measurement window
substantive_lineage.limitations: No improvement magnitude, patient count, revenue, or completion guarantee is implied.

substantive_lineage.label: F-001 specialty conversion math
substantive_lineage.canonical_value: booked evaluations / inquiries; starts / booked evaluations; completed plans / starts
substantive_lineage.unit: rates
substantive_lineage.formula: inquiry_to_book_rate = booked_evaluations / inquiries; book_to_start_rate = starts / booked_evaluations; completion_rate = completed_plans / starts
substantive_lineage.derivation: Direct rendering of F-001 impact_math with shorter display labels.
substantive_lineage.explanation: Plug-in measurement formulas; no counts or results are asserted.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Defines how the future lane baseline will be calculated.
substantive_lineage.limitations: Denominators may be zero or missing; missing counts must remain null. No forecast is present.

substantive_lineage.label: F-002 access diagnostic math
substantive_lineage.unit: count and rate
substantive_lineage.formula: access_gap_count = unanswered_or_abandoned_calls + booking_attempts_without_completion + requests_without_acceptable_slot; realized_gap_rate = access_gap_count / total_access_attempts
substantive_lineage.derivation: Direct rendering of F-002 impact_math with equivalent plain-language variable names.
substantive_lineage.explanation: Diagnostic formulas; the page asserts no current gap count or rate.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Defines what must be measured before changing hours or staffing.
substantive_lineage.limitations: Requires mutually understood disposition rules and a nonzero total-attempt denominator. No leakage is assumed.

substantive_lineage.label: F-003 channel baseline math
substantive_lineage.display_value: listing accuracy; review velocity per 30 days; referral or recall book rate
substantive_lineage.canonical_value: correct tracked listings / tracked listings; new verified reviews / 30 days; booked / eligible inquiries or contacts
substantive_lineage.unit: rates and reviews per 30 days
substantive_lineage.formula: listing_accuracy_rate = correct_tracked_listings / tracked_listings; review_velocity = new_verified_reviews / 30_days; referral_book_rate = booked_referred_patients / referral_inquiries; recall_book_rate = booked_recall_patients / eligible_recall_contacts
substantive_lineage.derivation: Rendered F-003 math combines the two canonical referral/recall formulas into 'booked / eligible inquiries or contacts.'
substantive_lineage.explanation: Baseline formulas; no listing defect, review velocity, referral rate, or recall rate is asserted.
substantive_lineage.why_on_page: Defines measurable channel hygiene before broader awareness work.
substantive_lineage.limitations: Tracked-surface scope, verified-review rules, eligibility rules, and zero-denominator handling must be defined before calculation.
